title: Data Supplement for 'Dynamic induction control for mitigation of wake-induced power losses: a wind tunnel study under different inflow conditions'
question: How does turbine control change downstream wake recovery and measured power under the retained inflow condition?
publisher: Zúñiga Inestroza, Manuel Alejandro (ForWind Zentrum für Windenergieforschung); Hulsman, Paul (ForWind Zentrum für Windenergieforschung); Petrović, Vlaho (ForWind Zentrum für Windenergieforschung); Kühn, Martin (ForWind Zentrum für Windenergieforschung)
measurement_dates: Measurement dates not established in metadata.
variables_and_units: wake velocity, position, Strouhal settings and power
independent_units: turbine configuration, inflow and complete runs
validation_design: turbine configuration, inflow and complete runs Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Lidar-derived/interpolated velocity fields and measured turbine power; WF_Power also contains virtual third-turbine power and other inflow columns. Published DIC analyses are prior results.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Use ABL Type II consistently. Virtual power is a prediction, not a third independent measured turbine. Leave out complete operating conditions/positions; no field-farm extrapolation claim.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
